import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import triton
import triton.language as tl
torch.backends.cudnn.allow_tf32 = False
torch.backends.cuda.matmul.allow_tf32 = False
torch.backends.cudnn.deterministic = True
torch.backends.cudnn.benchmark = False
@triton.jit
def custom_kernel(
    x_ptr, w_ptr, b_ptr, out_ptr,
    N, CIN, D, H, W,
    COUT, DOUT, HOUT, WOUT,
    stride_xn, stride_xc, stride_xd, stride_xh, stride_xw,
    stride_wco, stride_wci, stride_wkd, stride_wkh, stride_wkw,
    stride_on, stride_oc, stride_od, stride_oh, stride_ow,
    NUM_CO_BLOCKS,
    K: tl.constexpr,
    CIN_PER_GROUP: tl.constexpr,
    BLOCK_CIN: tl.constexpr,
    GROUPS: tl.constexpr,
    STRIDE: tl.constexpr,
    PADDING: tl.constexpr,
    DILATION: tl.constexpr,
    HAS_BIAS: tl.constexpr,
    BLOCK_HW: tl.constexpr,
    BLOCK_CO: tl.constexpr,
):
    pid_nc = tl.program_id(0)
    pid_d = tl.program_id(1)
    pid_hw = tl.program_id(2)
    n64 = (pid_nc // NUM_CO_BLOCKS).to(tl.int64)
    co_block = pid_nc % NUM_CO_BLOCKS
    cout_per_group = COUT // GROUPS
    blocks_per_group = tl.cdiv(cout_per_group, BLOCK_CO)
    group = co_block // blocks_per_group
    local_block = co_block % blocks_per_group
    co_start = group * cout_per_group + local_block * BLOCK_CO
    co_offsets = co_start + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_CO)
    group_end = (group + 1) * cout_per_group
    mask_co = (co_offsets < COUT) & (co_offsets < group_end)
    co64 = co_offsets.to(tl.int64)
    group64 = group.to(tl.int64)
    od = pid_d
    offs = pid_hw * BLOCK_HW + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_HW)
    hw_total = HOUT * WOUT
    mask_hw = offs < hw_total
    oh = offs // WOUT
    ow = offs % WOUT
    acc = tl.zeros((BLOCK_CO, BLOCK_HW), dtype=tl.float32)
    for kd in range(K):
        id_ = od * STRIDE - PADDING + kd * DILATION
        valid_d = (id_ >= 0) & (id_ < D)
        id64 = id_.to(tl.int64)
        for kh in range(K):
            ih = oh * STRIDE - PADDING + kh * DILATION
            valid_h = (ih >= 0) & (ih < H)
            ih64 = ih.to(tl.int64)
            for kw in range(K):
                iw = ow * STRIDE - PADDING + kw * DILATION
                valid_w = (iw >= 0) & (iw < W)
                iw64 = iw.to(tl.int64)
                mask = mask_hw & valid_d & valid_h & valid_w
                ci_range = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_CIN)
                mask_ci = ci_range < CIN_PER_GROUP
                ci_global = group64 * CIN_PER_GROUP + ci_range.to(tl.int64)
                x_offset = (
                    n64 * stride_xn
                    + ci_global[:, None] * stride_xc
                    + id64 * stride_xd
                    + ih64[None, :] * stride_xh
                    + iw64[None, :] * stride_xw
                )
                x_mask = mask_ci[:, None] & mask[None, :]
                x_val = tl.load(x_ptr + x_offset, mask=x_mask, other=0.0)
                w_offset = (
                    co64[:, None] * stride_wco
                    + ci_range[None, :] * stride_wci
                    + kd * stride_wkd
                    + kh * stride_wkh
                    + kw * stride_wkw
                )
                w_mask = mask_co[:, None] & mask_ci[None, :]
                w_val = tl.load(w_ptr + w_offset, mask=w_mask, other=0.0)
                acc += tl.dot(w_val.to(tl.float32), x_val.to(tl.float32), allow_tf32=False)

        bias_val = tl.load(b_ptr + co64, mask=mask_co, other=0.0)
        acc += bias_val.to(tl.float32)[:, None]

        n64 * stride_on
        + co64[:, None] * stride_oc
        + od.to(tl.int64) * stride_od
        + oh.to(tl.int64)[None, :] * stride_oh
        + ow.to(tl.int64)[None, :] * stride_ow
    )
    out_mask = mask_co[:, None] & mask_hw[None, :]
    tl.store(out_ptr + out_offset, acc.to(tl.float32), mask=out_mask)
